mixing.mixing_status: the democratic base DERIVES sin^2 theta_12 = 1/3 (8% from the observed 0.307): it is the squared overlap of any family basis vector with the UNIQUE heavy eigenvector (1,1,1)/sqrt(3).  It does NOT derive sin^2 theta_23 or sin^2 theta_13: both sweep [0, 2/3] under the O(2) freedom of the 2-fold light subspace.  TBM (1/3, 1/2, 0) is the (23)-adapted member of that family; (12), (13) and (23) are equivalent symmetries of |1><1|, so WHICH one breaks is an extra input.  The CKM from identical up/down democratic matrices is the IDENTITY, not the TBM.

hierarchy.structure: one heavy + a 2-fold light level (the 0-parameter base)

higgs_dirac.note: the 10-Higgs 16->16-bar is the 0-parameter Dirac term (rank 16, off-diagonal)

data.residual: the exact 3-gen hierarchy (the 10-Higgs vev breaking, the ratios m1:m2:m3) and the exact CKM/PMNS angles beyond the TBM (O6); sin^2_23 and sin^2_13 are an O(2) choice, not a derivation
